title: OpenAI tightens its rules for increasingly hard-to-control AI models
teaser: OpenAI has revised its Model Spec to say more clearly how AI agents should behave when they can take actions on their own. The rules emphasize that models must remain open to oversight, correction and shutdown, and should warn people about the consequences of what they do. That matters because the document sets out intended behaviour; it does not establish that models reliably follow it.
